_note: Career Map data. Faculty can suggest edits through a pull request. 'offered': false keeps a course on the map, faded, and never recommends it. Each job needs exactly 3 strategy and 4 skills courses that are offered. 'role' links the job to the Path Finder job of the same code in role-content.json and job-data.json.

jobs.title: Junior Art Director
jobs.where: Creative department at an ad agency
jobs.why: The NYC posting asked for strong Photoshop and InDesign, print experience, a portfolio of student or spec work, and After Effects or Premiere as a plus. Stay on the Advertising line and add type, photo, video and content skills.
jobs.internship: Creative department at an ad agency, ideally paired with a copywriter
jobs.seniorProject: An integrated campaign for one brand: print, a video spot and social, with concept boards.

jobs.title: Social Media Designer
jobs.also: Also listed as Designer / Social Media Creator
jobs.where: PR firm, agency, or in-house brand team
jobs.why: These jobs mix design, short video and writing. Swap the portfolio course for Storytelling for Creatives, and spend your skills courses on content and video.
jobs.postedPay: $51K to $74K a year (M Booth, NYC). A larger tech brand listed $80K to $95K (Fiverr, NYC).
jobs.internship: Social team at an agency, PR firm, or brand
jobs.seniorProject: A social campaign system: templates, short motion posts and a month of planned content.

jobs.title: Junior Graphic Designer
jobs.where: In-house brand team or design studio
jobs.why: Hiring managers look for strong type and for one idea held together across many pieces. Take the full Graphic Design line.
jobs.postedPay: $66K (maman, NYC) and $70K to $80K (Related, NYC). PayScale puts most NYC junior graphic designers between $45K and $66K.
jobs.robertHalf: Graphic Designer: $72K low, $94K mid, $111K high (2027 guide)
jobs.internship: A design studio or a brand's in-house creative team
jobs.seniorProject: An identity system carried across print, packaging, signage and digital.

jobs.title: Junior Packaging Designer
jobs.where: Consumer products company or packaging agency
jobs.why: Packaging teams want proof you can build a file a printer can use. Copywriting helps because every package has to sell in a few words.
jobs.postedPay: $52K to $65K (Best Brands Consumer Products, Edison NJ)
jobs.robertHalf: Package Designer: $76K low, $92K mid, $113K high (2026 guide)
jobs.internship: A packaging agency or a consumer brand's design team
jobs.seniorProject: A product line with real dielines, printed prototypes and shelf mockups.

jobs.title: Production Artist
jobs.where: Agency, publisher, or a retailer's in-house studio
jobs.why: Production artists keep big campaigns accurate, and it's a common first job. Campaign Development shows you how a campaign is planned before you build all its pieces.
jobs.postedPay: $19 to $38 an hour on NYC listings (ZipRecruiter)
jobs.robertHalf: Production Artist: $74K low, $89K mid, $103K high (2027 guide)
jobs.internship: In-house studio at a retailer, publisher, or agency
jobs.seniorProject: One campaign or catalog rolled out across many sizes and formats, with print-ready files and a spec sheet.

jobs.title: Junior Motion Designer
jobs.also: Also listed as Jr. Motion Graphics Designer / Animator
jobs.where: Agency, media company, or sports and entertainment brand
jobs.why: A motion reel gets you hired. Take the full Motion line, and borrow Storyboard Concepts so your reel shows planning as well as finish.
jobs.postedPay: $25 to $27 an hour (Serino Coyne, NYC, a combined editor and motion role). MSG Sports has also posted a Junior Motion Designer role.
jobs.robertHalf: Motion Designer: $105K low, $124K mid, $148K high (2027 guide)
jobs.internship: A motion studio or a media company's in-house team
jobs.seniorProject: An animated brand package: logo animation, title cards and social cutdowns.

jobs.title: Brand + Motion Designer
jobs.why: More brand teams want one person who can design the system and make it move. Borrow Identity Design from Graphic Design and add Advanced Typography.
jobs.internship: A brand team that makes its own content
jobs.seniorProject: A brand identity that moves: the static system plus rules for how it animates.

jobs.title: Junior Video Editor
jobs.where: Production company, agency, or media company
jobs.why: Editors are judged on pacing and story. Video Production for Commercials and Photography II build your camera and lighting eye.
jobs.postedPay: $25 to $27 an hour (Serino Coyne, NYC, a combined editor and motion role)
jobs.robertHalf: Video Editor: $83K low, $99K mid, $123K high (2027 guide)
jobs.internship: A post-production house or an agency's video team
jobs.seniorProject: A short commercial or mini documentary you shoot, cut, color and mix, plus social cutdowns.

jobs.title: Junior Designer, Children's Books
jobs.where: Art department at a book publisher
jobs.why: Publishing art departments hire people who can draw and also lay out a page. Borrow Storytelling for Creatives, and take Publication Design and Advanced Typography from Graphic Design.
jobs.postedPay: $55K (Simon & Schuster, Little Simon / Simon Spotlight imprints, NYC)
jobs.internship: A publisher's art department or a magazine
jobs.seniorProject: A picture book dummy or a series of book covers, with type.

jobs.title: Junior Print / Textile Designer
jobs.why: Brands need a steady supply of graphics and patterns, and some lines are built on licensed characters. Clean vector work and seamless repeats are the job, and Brand Strategy helps you design for a label's look.
jobs.postedPay: The NYC-area posting we found (Jersey City) did not list pay. Junior apparel design roles in Manhattan listed $55K to $75K.
jobs.internship: Print or graphics team at an apparel brand
jobs.seniorProject: A seasonal collection of prints with repeat patterns, colorways and product mockups.

jobs.title: Junior UX/UI Designer
jobs.also: Also listed as Junior Product Designer
jobs.where: Tech company, agency, or public agency
jobs.why: Product teams hire from case studies that show research, testing and a clear reason for each choice. Information Design trains you to make complex content clear, and motion helps you prototype how screens behave.
jobs.postedPay: $49K to $83K on NYC junior UX listings (ZipRecruiter). Most NYC product design openings ask for experience, so many people start through an internship or contract role.
jobs.robertHalf: UX Designer: $134K low, $165K mid, $198K high (2027 guide). This is where the role goes with experience.
jobs.internship: Product team at a startup, agency, or city agency
jobs.seniorProject: A researched and tested app or service, with a case study that explains your decisions.

jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.where: Web agency or in-house marketing team
jobs.why: A site that is live and working beats any mockup. Marketing sites are brand work on screen, so Identity Design, Advanced Typography and content skills pay off.
jobs.postedPay: $21 to $37 an hour on NYC Webflow designer listings (ZipRecruiter). PayScale shows about $51K for NYC web designers with under a year of experience.
jobs.seniorProject: A live website launched for a real client.

jobs.title: Digital Designer
jobs.why: Digital designers handle everything a brand puts on a screen. Campaign Development, content and motion give you range across formats.
jobs.postedPay: We didn't find a junior listing with pay. Robert Half names digital designers among the roles employers most want for 2026.
jobs.robertHalf: Digital Designer: $93K low, $112K mid, $137K high (2027 guide)
jobs.seniorProject: One campaign built as a system across a landing page, email and display ads.
